prompts.ui:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production game UI sprite atlas, 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 icons. Create a beautiful premium kawaii 3D clay-toy icon sheet for Mimo, a pastel squishy dumpling care game for children. Genuine transparent background, no background tiles, no text, no borders. Soft warm studio light, subtle ambient occlusion, creamy glossy porcelain and squishy silicone, rounded forms, polished hand-crafted shapes, pastel lavender/pink/mint/butter yellow/peach. Consistent front-three-quarter camera, readable silhouette, high craftsmanship, expressive but not cluttered. Square canvas; uniform 4x4 cells. Every icon fully contained in its cell with generous transparent padding, centered at cell center, uses about 70% cell width/height. No elements crossing cell edges. Do NOT render a checkerboard.
Row 1 left to right: 1 a beautiful round glass potion bottle full of swirling rainbow pastel paint with a gold cork; 2 pair of white bunny ears with blush pink velvet insides; 3 a curled lavender fluffy tail; 4 pair of large dark chocolate glossy cute eyes with white sparkles.
Row 2: 5 lavender round glasses with clear lenses; 6 small gold crown with lavender gems; 7 pearly mint fairy wings; 8 a lustrous iridescent pearl with two small gold sparkle stars.
Row 3: 9 pastel peach bowl with three colorful fruits and a tiny spoon (food); 10 turquoise bathtub with foam and yellow rubber duck (bath); 11 pastel toy ball and a little pennant (play); 12 round bamboo steamer with a tiny happy pink dumpling, lid slightly open (create).
Row 4: 13 happy pink dumpling jumping above its small soft shadow, curved squashy dumpling body, tiny shiny eyes; 14 two tiny pastel pink and blue dumplings playing chase; 15 sleepy pink dumpling resting on lavender pillow; 16 golden sponge with white soap bubbles.
Make the result look like real polished 3D rendered app/game artwork, never line art, flat vector, emoji, or geometric code drawing. NO lettering, labels, watermark, frame. EXACT ordered 4x4 grid.
